public_commits.message:
Freeze R9 protocol before new cohort chart calculations

Fixed Brazil2006 reference, fixed 2000-record source slots, synthetic calibration gates, conditional source-frame intervals, and separated AI evidence track. Birth-field quality/schema audits were visible; no new cohort scores or outcomes were inspected.
Seal R9 fixed-reference implementation and synthetic calibration before cohort inspection
Freeze separate R9 verification implementation before target aggregation

interpretation: Protocol public before scoring. Implementation/calibration public before target distribution inspection, not before all scoring. Separate reviewer implementation public before aggregation. This is project-public chronology, not external preregistration or peer review.
